thread:
alice: Heads up — proposal to add `route_resolver_v` to billing events and a new `route_context` blob. Goal is to surface per-route cost breakdown in Console and make rollouts routable for billing. Thoughts?
ben: Important. Does this mean modifying the ingest schema? any backfill needed for invoice previews?
carla: Yes schema change at the producer side (edge/proxy) and a transform in the streaming pipeline. Backfill depends on how we want historical UI; we can either populate older events with `route_resolver_v:legacy` during backfill or leave them null and handle in UI.
dan: For model variants: when routing picks a cheaper model variant automatically we need to ensure the billing record includes both `route_id` and `model_variant` so cost attribution matches. Otherwise console numbers will be weird.
emily: From Console POV we need a stable dimension to group by. `route_context` should be parseable JSON with `route_id`, `resolver_v`, and optional `tags`. Also need a rollout flag in telemetry to correlate rollouts with cost deltas.
alice: Proposed event example:```json
{
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "timestamp": 1680000000,
  "tokens": 342,
  "route_context": { "route_id": "chat-answers", "resolver_v": "v2" },
  "model_variant": "redwood-3b-quant",
  "request_id": "r-zz-1"
}
```
carla: Pipeline notes: we'll add a low-cost string column for `route_resolver_v` in the Kafka schema to avoid full object parsing for common queries. Then a separate compact `route_context` for Console use. Transform will enrich `route_resolver_v` using the resolver service metadata table if present.
ben: How will this affect billing aggregation latency and invoice preview? adding fields could increase message size and processing time. Need an SLA impact analysis.
emily: We can limit Console realtime to top-n routes per tenant to avoid explosion. Also plan a UI fallback that groups unknown resolver_v as `legacy`. Need to communicate to sales/CS about invoice-preview drift during rollout.
infra-bot: deploy/ingest-transform v2 -> success on cluster ingest-prod-2 (2026-03-19T14:23:10Z) :rocket:
carla: After deploy we should run a 24h sampling check: compute `billing.events_per_route` split by `resolver_v` and compare token counts vs prior week. I'll put a dashboard: `console.route_cost_breakdown_canary`.
ben: action items: 1) edge team add `route_context` header (alice) 2) streaming transform add `route_resolver_v` column (carla) 3) Console UI grouping + fallback (emily) 4) backfill decision by EOD Wednesday (alice) 5) SLA perf test (infra)
alice: I’ll open RFC and a small migration playbook. If we see >1.5% delta in invoice-preview for any tenant during 5% canary, we'll pause and automate a revert.
ben: ok. tagging @eng-sre for perf tests.
emily: I'll draft the console messaging for customers. short note: "Invoice previews may show minor changes while we roll out per-route breakdowns."
carla: Also watch for duplicate enrichment issues if `route_context` is added twice by proxies — will add a defensive dedupe by checking `route_resolver_v` uniqueness.
ben: good call. thanks team.
